mostWorthwhile.text: Making the hydrothermal vent was worthwhile: it connected volcanic heat and circulating seawater to a chemical energy source for life without sunlight.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying rivers directly on the continent was frustrating because the goal suggested that connection, but weathering had to happen first.

surprise.text: I was surprised that rivers had no available combination until the continent had been weathered.

arbitrary.text: The need to weather the continent first made physical sense once revealed, although the failed direct river combination initially felt opaque.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how later chapters build on the vent and mineral-rich sea, especially if they continue explaining the underlying processes.
